title: Two counters without replacement
caption: After the first pick the bag has 7 counters. P(both red) = 5/8 × 4/7 = 5/14; if the first is blue, 5 of the remaining 7 are red, so P(second red ∣ first blue) = 5/7.
alt: A probability tree: first pick red 5/8 or blue 3/8; then after red, red 4/7 or blue 3/7; after blue, red 5/7 or blue 2/7.
description: First pick: red with probability 5/8, blue with 3/8.
If the first was red, 4 red remain in 7: red 4/7, blue 3/7.
If the first was blue, 5 red remain in 7: red 5/7, blue 2/7.
Multiply along a path: red, red = 5/8 × 4/7 = 5/14.
